correctness.rationale: Equation E(X,Y)=4Q(X)Y-2tr(XY)X follows from trace-zero Cayley–Hamilton. The isotropic X have rank-one adjoint squares and q²-element Y fibers; nonisotropic X have rank-two maps with q-element fibers; exact conic and orthogonal-plane counts produce all four outputs. Characteristic two makes [sl2,sl2] central, so E=0. Direct independent-multiplication checker passed for q=2,3,4,5,7,9 including extension fields.

value.rationale: A complete natural word-value distribution for the first semisimple matrix Lie algebra is strictly finer than existing surjectivity statements. It exhibits quantified nilpotent/semisimple bias, a square/nonsquare per-target asymmetry but exact total mass balance, and an abrupt characteristic-two collapse, all structurally motivated by the Lie quadratic form.
